toolOutage.persistence: Confirmed present again today, 2026-10-12; present in every daily hunt commit since mid-July 2026 per git log — roughly 3 months, unresolved despite being reported in the searchLog each day
toolOutage.likelyImpact: Zero opportunities can be verified from any company's actual careers page regardless of how good the lead is (Databricks APM lead today is a concrete example of a probably-real, unverifiable opportunity); if src/brief.js falls back to the paid API hunter on empty results, this has likely been driving the recurring Anthropic API spend flagged in life/PIPELINE.md
toolOutage.fix: This is an environment/network-policy setting (egress allowlist for the life-hub-daily / hunt routine's cloud sandbox), not something fixable from inside the session. Needs to be widened to at least standard job-board domains (greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, myworkday.com) and ideally general web domains, or WebFetch verification of non-Anthropic opportunities will never be possible here.
